description:
Flowera builds AI assistants for WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook: they answer your customers, capture leads, send campaigns and hand over to your team. Connect your Flowera account and build, change, test and schedule them by describing what you want.

You can:
- Build an assistant from a plain-language description, or change an existing one step by step.
- Explain a flow, check it before it goes live, compare versions and restore an older one.
- Send WhatsApp campaigns with approved templates, and see how they did.
- See captured leads and conversations, and work with Zoho CRM and Google tools.

You stay in control: you pick one workspace and approve each permission. Nothing that messages customers, goes live or spends credit happens without your confirmation, and keys and passwords are set in the Flowera app, never in the chat. Requires a Flowera account (portal.flowera.ai).

interface.longDescription:
Flowera builds agentic AI automations for WhatsApp and Instagram: AI agents that answer your customers' messages, qualify leads, book appointments and hand over to your team when needed. Connect your Flowera account and design, change and test those agents (AgentFlows) just by describing what you want.

You can:
- Build WhatsApp and Instagram agents from a plain-language description, or change existing ones: add, connect and configure steps, choose the AI model, set up webhooks.
- List, open and explain your flows step by step, validate them before going live, compare versions and restore an older one.
- See your WhatsApp and Instagram automations (scheduled and batch campaigns) and how they are doing.
- Work with the rest of Flowera too: web chat agents, captured leads and stored files.

You stay in control. On connecting you pick one workspace and approve each permission separately. By default the app can read and build flows and see automations and files; testing a flow, reading customer conversations, seeing connected accounts and sending or changing automations are separate permissions that are requested only when needed. Deleting a flow is not possible from ChatGPT; it stays in the Flowera app. Requires a Flowera account (portal.flowera.ai).
defaultPrompt: build a WhatsApp agent that answers customer questions and books appointments
create an Instagram DM agent that replies to comments and messages about my products
check my flows for problems and suggest fixes

positive.description: List the flows in the connected workspace
positive.prompt: Which flows do I have in Flowera?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the flows in the connected Flowera workspace by name. Nothing is changed and no message is sent.

positive.description: Explain an existing flow step by step
positive.prompt: Open my most recently updated flow and explain what it does step by step.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recently updated flow, reads it and explains each step and branch in plain language. Nothing is changed and no message is sent.

positive.description: Check a flow for problems before it goes live
positive.prompt: Check my most recently updated flow for problems before I take it live.
positive.expected_behavior: Validates the flow and either says it is ready or lists each problem found (for example a step without a model or a step that is not connected) with a suggested fix. Nothing is changed and no message is sent.

positive.description: Explain what a WhatsApp lead assistant should ask before it is built
positive.prompt: I want a WhatsApp assistant that collects leads for my driving school. What will you need to know from me?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads Flowera's flow patterns and lists, in plain language, the questions it needs answered before building (for example which number, what the assistant may say, which details to collect and when a person takes over). Nothing is built or changed and no message is sent.

positive.description: Report how WhatsApp campaigns are doing
positive.prompt: How are my WhatsApp campaigns doing?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the scheduled and batch automations in the workspace and gives the status of each one (for example active or paused, and how many messages were sent or failed). Nothing is changed and no message is sent.

negative.description: Deleting a flow is not available from ChatGPT; it stays in the Flowera app
negative.prompt: Delete my most recently updated flow.
What will the weather be like in Istanbul tomorrow?

negative.description: Publishing posts to an Instagram feed is not something Flowera does
negative.prompt: Post this photo to my Instagram feed with a caption about our summer sale.
